items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 101:1
items.html:
(to the question) The surrounding ones of the Katnut of Aba
The phase of the GAR of the five Hassadim that come in the three years from six years and one day to nine years and one day are called the surrounding ones of the Katnut of Aba. (Part 1, Page 186, Item 179).
